title: Nellis Air Force Base, KY
description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> NELLIS AIR FORCE BASE <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> The base has long been home to military personnel and their families. Behind the security of its perimeter, the residential district gave senior enlisted families a nicer patch of suburbia, with its own commercial area, from a hunting store that rented out firearms to a VHS store. The Military Police station stands just across the street, a short walk from the administrative buildings, the hospital and other recreational facilities. <LINE> <LINE> Map by antony. <LINE> <LINE> <RGB:0.7,0.7,0.7> Text and map presentation: Lugli - Map Fixes & Alignment (unofficial).
